title: Staging Recovery authority binding and genuine signed certification

phases.objective: Bind a deployment-owned, durable and fully typed 14-component Recovery authority graph into explicit local Windows/Docker Staging, expose trusted pre-certification readiness without synthesizing a certificate, and keep Production, Local Connector and external-provider authority fail-closed.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: server root loads ./stagingRecoveryAuthorityBinding.js in injected_non_live mode
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The Staging Recovery composition has all 14 real server-managed authority components, durable and attestation capabilities, typed provenance and an independent readiness evidence root; /admin/recovery/staging/readiness can compute HTTP-200 blocked readiness with authority_graph.ready=true while genuine certification and external evidence remain absent.
steps: Resolve an explicit staging_local_windows_docker runtime and reject Production, unknown or conflicting runtime identities.
Load the deployment-owned binding module from the Staging image with injected_non_live mode only.
Derive deployment identity from the exact image deployment manifest and derive a durable target fingerprint from persistent server-owned target identity.

Construct the complete 14-component Recovery graph with durable filesystem state, approval/ticket authorities, fenced locking, bounded Staging canary execution, same-store ticket verification, immutable receipts and durable ledger.
Expose typed mad4b.recovery-adapter-provenance.v1 for every component and attest durability/attestation capabilities.
Keep /app/data/recovery-readiness independent from /app/data/recovery-ingress and expose a dynamic atomic current-certification pointer without requiring restart.
With no certification pointer, return trusted pre-certification snapshot data but authenticity_verified=false and no stagingCertification.
Evaluate Staging Recovery Admin readiness and require authority_graph.ready=true while certification and external-evidence checks remain blocking.
assertions: No mock, dummy, in-memory or test-double adapter is installed by the deployment-owned Staging module.
The recoveryStore retains the exact injected executionTicketVerifier object and durable claims/reservations are filesystem-backed.
Production and unknown runtimes fail closed before a binding envelope can be returned.
No Local Connector input or connector.mad4b.com dependency enters the authority graph.
No Production deployment, Production mutation, database mutation, provider mutation, DNS mutation, migration apply or ruleset mutation is authorized by Phase A.
A missing certification is represented as blocked readiness, never as a synthetic signed pass.
If a current-certification pointer appears without valid configured signing trust, the existing authority fails closed immediately.

phases.objective: Run genuine exact-SHA Staging Recovery certification only after Phase A reaches authority_graph.ready=true with certification/external evidence as the remaining blockers.

planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: A dedicated certification signer produces a verified immutable exact-SHA Staging certification record, the atomic current-certification pointer advances only after verification, and public signed-ingress readback reports ready=true and certification valid=true without Production or Local Connector authority.
steps: Require exact current main, exact deployed Staging SHA, exact Worker SHA and exact durable target fingerprint.
Execute the canonical Recovery lifecycle through durable evidence and same-fence readback.
Run the canonical negative certification suite and require every case to pass.
Collect fresh registration, OAuth, network and Worker deployment evidence bound to the same deployment and target.

Build stagingCertification and outer Recovery readiness evidence, sign with a dedicated Ed25519 certification key outside the app, persist immutable evidence, verify it, and atomically move current-certification.
Verify public activation-dev.mad4b.com signed-ingress readiness and certification readbacks.

phases.objective: Production Recovery activation and Production mutation remain outside this feature and require a separate governed release and authorization lifecycle.
blockers: This feature is Staging-only and does not grant Production Recovery execution authority.
Production deployment, Hostinger/provider/database mutation, Production trusted-ingress changes and Production activation require separate governance.
